C-SELECTION.IntentSummary:
Task slices and skill subsetting (D15): ngrace context --task / --skills as separate read-only outputs; Purpose Title + Satisfies→AC wording identity; plan-scope DurableScope and ObservedWriteScope with shared-scope sentence (A48.4); absolute exclusions; full envelope measurement in utf8-bytes with enumerated composition; toolkit stage only.
Authored before production code per A17.3. A47 is normative over §8.3–§8.5; A48 is normative where it answers A47.3 and amends §8.5.4 (corr 133). Build order: pure normalizer and ratio helpers, slice composition, skill candidates, CLI surface, skills, real-repo measurements.

T-001.Title: Slice composition: Purpose, body, shared scope, exclusions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Purpose is Title + Satisfies→AC bodies after corr 120 normalizer (A47.2 116/120/131). Body is plan DurableScope modules/verification via existing queries; OWS plan-level with AC-SELECTION-SCOPE-IS-SHARED sentence (A48.4). design-context, sibling archive content, other task bodies, and default .ngrace/context/* excluded (A47.2 122–123, 126). Archived subject names subjectLocation archive in the output (A48.1).

T-002.Title: Skill candidates, stage field, and measurement envelope

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Three states → three skill sets; absent cursor → full published set; each candidate has basis; selectionStage toolkit only and labelled as sole value observed (A48.3, corr 125). full envelope is A48.2 enumerated files (no design-context); selectedBytes defined like-for-like; selected >= full reported not coerced; skill ratio separate.

T-003.Title: CLI surface, package files entry, execute skill
